title: 段落匹配的定位词
goal: 选择有区分度的定位词并识别原文变体。

points.label: 选出有区分度的定位词
识别定位词在原文中的变体

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲
sources.used: 阅读课程内容与材料形式

body.p: 定位词是用来缩小查找范围的具体信息。人名、地名、数字和具体名词出现次数少，区分度比各段共有的主题词高。

body.box: A survey of the town's libraries mentions the Bracken branch once and libraries in every paragraph. Statement: The Bracken branch extended its opening hours.

body.p: Bracken 能把这个分馆和其他分馆区分开。找到名称后，还要核对延长开放时间这个动作。只凭名称相同还不能确定对应。

cards.title: 定位词的区分度
rows: Dr. Lin compared two seed samples.
Lin 可区分其他研究者
The trial continued for six weeks.
six weeks 可区分试验时长
bicycle journeys 可区分出行方式
survey 各段都有，先查 bicycle journeys

cards.title: 定位词的变体
rows: The scheme ran for twelve months.
The survey was conducted over twelve months.
The researcher Rao examined the samples.
The museum on River Street lent tools.
The library opened in May. It bought a printer.

body.box:
A report discusses several transport projects.
[A] The Harbor route carries passengers between the station and the market.
[B] The Moor route was extended after a study lasting twelve months. The extension serves a hospital.
[C] The Valley route is operated by volunteers on weekends.

Statement: A year-long study preceded an extension serving a hospital.

body.p: 优先查 hospital 和 year-long study。第二段的 hospital 原词复现，twelve months 对应 year-long，was extended 对应 extension。
再核对先后：after a study 表示先做研究，后延长线路。其他段也讲线路，但没有同时提到研究时长和医院。

groups.text: A report mentions museums in every paragraph, but names the Alder Museum once. The Alder Museum has an evening opening.

items.stem: Which phrase best distinguishes the relevant museum?
items.why: Alder Museum 只出现一次，能区分其他博物馆。

groups.text: A report discusses several school meals. Only one paragraph mentions lentils served at lunch.

items.stem: Which expression is most useful for finding the paragraph about lentils?
items.why: lentils 仅在一个段落出现，比共同话题 school meals 有区分度。

groups.text: The trial of the new timetable continued for twelve months before the operator reviewed it.

items.stem: Which expression in the statement corresponds to twelve months?
items.why: twelve months 就是一年，对应 one year，即第一项。

groups.text: Professor Imani gathered samples from the river. The researcher later compared them in a laboratory.

items.stem: Who does the researcher refer to?
items.why: The researcher 指前句采样的 Professor Imani。

groups.text: A report about coastal projects names the Selby pier only once. The pier has a ramp for wheelchairs.

items.stem: Which phrase best locates the statement about wheelchair access at Selby?
items.why: Selby pier 是只出现一次的专名，适合定位。

groups.text: The council installed cycle racks by the station. The bicycle stands were painted blue.

items.stem: Which phrase restates cycle racks in the passage?
items.why: bicycle stands 与 cycle racks 指相同设施。

groups.text: An article discusses several public parks. It names the Maple Park once, in a sentence about a pond.

items.stem: Which phrase best locates the paragraph about that particular park?
items.why: Maple Park 是只出现一次的专名，可区分其他公园。

groups.text: A report discusses several studies of sleep. Only one study measured the sleep of nurses working night shifts.

items.stem: Which phrase best narrows a search for the study of those workers?
items.why: nurses working night shifts 指出只有一项研究涉及的群体。

groups.text: An article mentions many courses. Only one began in 1998, when the college opened its workshop.

items.stem: Which expression best identifies the course in the statement?
items.why: 原文说 Only one began in 1998。1998 只对应一门课程，比各段共有的 courses 更具体，即第二项。

groups.text: A group studied the stream for eighteen months before publishing its report.

items.stem: Which phrase describes the same period?
items.why: eighteen months 与 one and a half years 均为一年半。

groups.text: Dr. Sen surveyed households near the forest. The researcher then compared their answers with older records.

items.stem: Which person is referred to as the researcher?
items.why: The researcher 回指前句调查住户的 Dr. Sen。

groups.text: The city placed bicycle stands outside the station. Each cycle rack holds several bicycles.

items.stem: Which phrase refers to the bicycle stands?
items.why: cycle rack 与 bicycle stand 指停放自行车的设施。
